touched.task_desc: 1.1 **Implements spec Requirement "AI authoring shall fully enumerate all known elements of structured artifacts"** + supports design Goals (formalize the discipline, enable mechanical enforcement, resolve qef-product-master-redesign 9.2 ambiguity) + design D1 (Place MP160 in CH00 fundamental_principles / 03_development_methodology). 撰寫 `shared/global_scripts/00_principles/docs/en/part1_principles/CH00_fundamental_principles/03_development_methodology/MP160_ai_schema_bridge_authoring_completeness.qmd`,~250 行,結構參考 MP159 / MP154 模板。**Statement** 採 design.md 的 draft: "When AI authors structured artifacts that have an enumerable element set, the AI SHALL enumerate the set in full at authoring time. Partial-completion patterns are forbidden." **Rationale**(3 點): AI authoring time cheap vs rework expensive / partial scaffolding hides uncertainty / `/spectra-propose` Step 6 已在 spectra workflow 內 enforce, MP160 elevates to Tier-1。**Forbidden patterns** 列表(4 項,參考 spec.md): 空 optional_fields / TODO comments / N-of-M completion / ignored_columns 不完整。**Compliant patterns**(3 項): 12-of-12 一次寫完 / optional_fields 含 type+description+notes / ignored_columns exhaustive。**Files Bound** 列 5 個 paths(per spec.md)。**Change Discipline**(3 條): IC_P002 cross-co verify / validate_bridge_yaml.R 自動 reject / set equality check `set(source) === set(mapped) ∪ set(ignored)`。**Exemptions** 2 條(runtime-unknown types + wip/ subdir,addresses design R1 "MP160 適用邊界誤解" + R3 "WIP bridge 想 partial commit")。frontmatter 的 `binds:` 列出 5 個 paths,`related_to` 列 MP157/MP158/MP159/MP029/DM_R065/SO_R038。
